The topology_boundary_auditor shows high mask confidence (0.9159) but this doesn't rule out internal structural issues. The perceptual_quality_auditor found slight compression artifacts. I believe the Router underestimated the severity of the dancer anatomical issues - the expert evidence suggests this is a more severe problem than just one dancer on the far right.
